data.name: Natural Born Liar
data.description: At 1st level, when a charlatan successfully deceives a creature with a Bluff, that creature takes a - 2 penalty on the charlatan's Bluff checks for the next 24 hours. This ability does not stack with itself. This ability replaces trapfinding.
